data.name: Razi
data.gender_notes: Razi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is guided or enlightened by Allah. The name Razi carries the meaning “Guided, enlightened” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Razi usually hope their child will grow to embody guided, enlightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Quranic Arabic, Razi means 'content' or 'satisfied'.
data.etymology: Razi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guided, enlightened.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Razi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
